tools.name: review_admission
tools.description: Opens saga's admission review pane for an issue: the staffing table (admission question 4, staffing_overrides) and the lens table (question 5, lens_declaration), each row with its own control. The operator's answers are recorded through scripts/admission.py, which validates them. Returns status submitted (with the answers recorded), dismissed, not-placed, unavailable, nothing-to-review, timed-out or error; on anything but submitted, print admission.py --render tables and collect the answers in the conversation.
